subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, storage ownership, and whether the audit belongs in memory-core, a plugin SDK seam, or an external bundle, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and cause-propagation contract before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader provenance work
options.body: Track the implementation under persistent-state provenance if maintainers want one architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize to plugin or MCP
options.body: Narrow or close core work only if maintainers decide existing plugin/MCP surfaces are sufficient without new core contracts.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, event schema, and cause-propagation contract before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already handled the issue as memory/security design and has recent history on memory plugin boundaries and flush ownership.
